answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Hadith & Sunnah Question ID: 9246 Country: India Title: I have heard, if anybody talks during azaan, he/she will not be able to say kalima during death. Please let me know how far it is true and also please let me know the reference of hadith. Question: I have heard, if anybody talks during azaan, he/she will not be able to say kalima during death. Please let me know how far it is true and also please let me know the reference of hadith. Answer ID: 9246 Posted on: Dec 18, 2023 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2294/1877=B/1429) It is baseless; we do not know any such hadith. It is desirable to be silent and respond while azan is called. Responding azan is not obligatory or wajib (necessary). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
